name: knitting
description: Knitters knit jumpers, scarves, hats and socks to the wearer's measure, handed over in person or shipped.

price.description: Each price: per item, per hour, or for the whole order, with a count for a pack, such as 3 pairs of socks.

deposit.description: What is paid before the knitting starts.

age.description: The wearer's age, or the ages it fits, in years.

footLength.description: The foot's length, heel to toe, for socks.

days.description: How many days the knitting takes.

yarns.description: The yarns it is knitted from, such as merino or cotton.

photos.description: Photos of work the knitter has done.

due.description: When the client needs it by, or the span it may come in.

handover.description: How it is handed over: in person, shipped, or both.

studio.description: Where the knitter works, or anywhere in the circle they will go.

hours.description: When the knitter or the client can meet, each week.

daysLate.description: How many days late it came.

again.description: Whether the writer would deal with them again.
